description: List the UK regulatory regimes (UKCA, WEEE, PSTI, toy safety, food contact, REACH, packaging EPR and others) that apply to a type of product imported from China, with what to ask the supplier for. Call with no product_type to list the product types.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

product_type.description: A product type such as 'toys', 'electronics' or 'furniture' (Chinese also works).
